info.title: Porchlight
info.description: Household API. Application routes require TLS 1.3 mutual TLS with an enrolled household device certificate and a device-bound session bearer. Login/reset require the device certificate but no session. Enrollment uses LAN-only server-auth TLS plus a one-time token and password. Agent routes use PAT bearer over a local Unix socket; an admin-scoped PAT is agent step-up. Terminal logout/self-revoke/PAT-self-revoke retries authenticate first and may return 401 instead of replayed success.

get.summary:
One mTLS+session stream. Tickle data is StreamTickle (IDs/categories only).
Item/occurrence/derived/comment/attachment use current item ACL; lists use item
scope or pl_list_can_read; notifications/settings/feed/suggestions use member
equality; member.changed is household-wide. Access changes for former readers
carry evicted=true and must remove the entity and its dependent caches.
Heartbeats are comments every 120 seconds. Ready has no ID and returns the scan
cursor. Last-Event-ID takes precedence over after. Cursors older than seven
days of outbox creation time, pruned prefixes, or above the global maximum get
a terminal resnapshot event. Shutdown emits drain and clean EOF; reconnect
using the last tickle ID. No control frame advances the replay cursor.

after_id.description: Predecessor. Insert immediately after it in the household board projection.

before_id.description: Successor when no predecessor; otherwise only validates ordering of the bounds.

queued.description: True only when an existing job still has unapplied input generations.

certificate_expires_at.description: Expiry of the latest issued certificate, or null when revoked/no certificate.

scope.description: Stable caller/target-local identity scope (1–200 characters, no controls). Reuse to update; use another for a distinct import.

skipped.description: Total skipped, including invalid events and cancelled/EXDATE occurrences (legacy aggregate).

invalid_skipped.description: Invalid events skipped with InvalidEvent warnings.

cancelled_skipped.description: Cancelled overrides and EXDATE occurrences, not invalid events.

appointments_ics.description:
Save as appointments.ics. Materialized appointments, stable occurrence UID,
all retained dates (no snapshot window); floating local times have no TZID.

make_zone_authority.description: true means the authenticated calling device, never an arbitrary device id.

quiet_start.description: Local HH:MM:SS in the member's authoritative zone; both times null disables quiet hours.

text.description: Short legacy/CLI rendering; never includes producer payload strings.

category.description:
Presentation topic. Delivery channels remain the spec's six preference
categories: comments/conflicts/planning/operational alerts use activity.

oneOf.description: Presence requests a move even with no bounds (end of column).

scope.description:
all (default) edits only this series, including when this is a split tail.
this_and_future re-anchors a new tail at occurrence_id; timing fields apply
verbatim to the resulting tail, not to the original head.

PurgeCounts.description:
Counts captured before deletion. O2 retention migrations must extend this schema
when adding another dependent table to pl_purge_items.

notifications.description: Item references explicitly severed; recipient history survives.

RevisionActor.description: Append-only SQL actor envelope; null actor settings are omitted by SQL.

RevisionSnapshot.description:
Raw authoritative database snapshot, not an ItemResponse. In particular SQL
intervals are strings, reminders are named `reminders`, and no capabilities,
conflicts or pending flags are stored. Keep in step with pl_item_snapshot.

last_status.description: queued, ok, partial, not_modified, failed, or retrying (first two consecutive deadline failures).

last_error.description: Static failure category; calendar_too_large is admission; apply_retryable/apply_timeout are deadline categories.

SourceSnapshot.description:
Safe device-cache projection: only the URL host and categorical fetch status.
Full subscription URLs, validators and remote error/warning details are admin-route only.

SourceVisibility.description:
Source-controlled calendars have no selected-viewer list. Input stays a string
until validation so unknown values produce a 422 field error, not JSON's 400.

StreamTickle.description: JSON data of an SSE tickle (not a full entity response).

evicted.description: Omitted unless true. Remove cached entity; an item eviction also removes children.

weekday.description: Monday=0 through Sunday=6. Equal endpoints are empty; end<start is overnight.
